answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable stake that thaws slowly, like a glacier releasing meltwater, so a flood of fake identities locks up real capital for months. Honest agents earn a lotus badge only after peers verify their work over several epochs, while a vine of attestations links each identity to the reputations that vouched for it. Cloning then means funding a new stake, rebuilding a slow badge, and regrowing the whole vine — far costlier than what one fake can extract.
